sources.title: LuffyTheFox/Ornith1.5-35B-A3B-Genesis-Hermes-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: What is Genesis? Genesis is post training data regeneration and calibrarion algorythm for neural networks (LLM) in GGUF format that I made with AI help during almost half a year of development. It's optimized, architecture independent, works with any model in GGUF format and based on mathematical statistics. I don't train or finetune models, I repair purity of signal in them instead on Google ...

sources.title: Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B-GGUF: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: Model Overview Overview Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B is a mixture-of-experts reasoning and coding model made by ornith-ai that activates approximately 3 billion parameters per token while maintaining a total of 35 billion parameters.

sources.title: Ornith-1.5: From Self-Scaffolding to Self-Improvement
sources.snippet: Ornith-1.5 extends the self-scaffolding framework introduced in Ornith-1.0 into a more complete self-improvement loop: the model proposes new tasks, generates task-specific scaffolds, and produces solution rollouts for reinforcement learning, continuously creating new learning experiences from which it can improve.

sources.title: Ornith-1.5 35B-A3B for DGX Spark - GitHub
sources.snippet: by Mia'a AI Lab Serve Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B — a ~35B mixture-of-experts model (~3B active params/token) from the Ornith team — on a single NVIDIA DGX Spark (GB10 / SM121, ~128 GB unified memory): NVFP4 checkpoint, vLLM, in-checkpoint MTP speculative decoding, and up to 256k context.
